name: Network {OS}

group.label: 04 · GROW
group.purpose: Turn value into distribution and revenue

tagline: Trusted relationship memory and network stewardship.

commands.name: /network
commands.does: Reviews the network as a portfolio.
commands.returns: Reciprocity, diversity, dormancy and neglect, each named.

commands.name: /person
commands.does: Builds a person brief from what is actually known.
commands.returns: What is known with provenance, what is missing, one thing to contribute.

commands.name: /meeting-prep
commands.does: Prepares you for a specific meeting.
commands.returns: Context, open loops, and the outcome you actually want.

commands.name: /interaction
commands.does: Captures what happened and what was promised.
commands.returns: An interaction record and commitments with owners and dates.

commands.name: /follow-up
commands.does: Drafts a loop-closing follow up in your voice.
commands.returns: An unsent draft awaiting approval on the exact text.

commands.name: /intro
commands.returns: Two consent asks, then the introduction once both sides agree.

commands.name: /nurture
commands.returns: A cadence with a reason per contact point and an explicit breathing list.

commands.name: /difficult-conversation
commands.returns: A plan naming the outcome, the opening words and the walk-away.

commands.name: /boundary
commands.returns: A boundary script and the consequence you will actually hold.

commands.name: /gathering
commands.returns: Guest logic, shape and hospitality detail.

handoffs.artifact: meeting records and the commitments made in them

requires_human_approval_for: sending any introduction, after both sides have opted in
sharing a person's information with another OS or another person
sending or publishing any contact-facing message text, on the exact wording
recording a sensitive fact, or promoting an inference to a fact
adding someone to a gathering guest list on another person's behalf
